sloka: विण्मूत्राशयमावृत्य प्रजानां परमार्तिकृत् ।रुरोध सर्वभूतानि यथा वर्षाणि वासवः ।। ७.३५.५० ॥
transliteration: viṇmūtrāśayamāvṛtya prajānāṁ paramārtikṛt ।rurodha sarvabhūtāni yathā varṣāṇi vāsavaḥ ।। 7.35.50 ॥

translations.english: Causing great distress to creatures by obstructing their excretory functions, he stopped all beings, just as Indra stops the rains.
